body: Chief on the scale-selector candidate 689f607: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS — lands after four small fixes. Independent run (archive, clean pin): view 34/34 JVM+JS, fixtures 96/96, compileAll. Fresh-context review with six probes confirmed: exact mapping without coercion (sentence-tagged paragraph, surface-unit-tagged sentence, scene-under-Episode all → Missing, no mark), Derived(_, Some) → typed Unresolved, v2 rendering matches D13 field order with one-pass NUL-safe escaping, V-E3 with a mid-situation ReaderAt cut (support == clipSupport(model.supporting), != full), duplicate sidecar row fails closed, non-feature marks identical across scales, twin prints scale/selection/resolved space/channel. REQUIRED before landing: (1) compiler.scala:39 FeatureSpaceId.unsafe("derived:" + short(32)) is a throwing constructor on a production path and duplicates features/derivation.scala:150-151's identity rule — use a checked constructor mapped into FeatureResolutionIssue or one shared helper in features (no throw, no duplicated rule); (2) ADR D13 pins field order/escaping but not the value grammars the checksum commits to — add one sentence each for horizon (omniscient | reader:<n>), feature (raw:… | derived:<hex>:basis:<hex|none>), scale (surface:<kind> | narrative:…), channel.i (<wireName>:<priority>); (3) atScale's trailing case _ => false (:741) would let a future CodexScale case select nothing silently — match on scale first with explicit inner target matches; (4) the WOG horizon test cuts at minSpan.endExclusive, which never splits a single-span target — add the mid-paragraph case. Nits for a follow-up note on the bead: Missing conflates undeclared space with zero-at-scale; observationCount is pre-horizon (document in the SidecarRequired Scaladoc); Scaladoc on canonicalString/label. Repost SHA + view/fixtures 3-platform evidence; I re-run and land (or you commit, as before).
